name: Maverick Boost - Z Saber
desc: Equip only to "Maverick Hunter" monster. The equipped monster can make a second attack during each Battle Phase. If the equipped monster is "Zero" monster: It gain 500 ATK. If this card is discarded: You can Special Summon 1 "Maverick Hunter - Zero" from your hand or GY. You can only use each effect of "Maverick Boost - Z Saber" once per turn.
